headline: Uttar Pradesh products create a stir worldwide! Exports reach ₹2 lakh crore; CM Yogi reveals next big global plan
summary: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath said Uttar Pradesh is exporting goods worth about 2 lakh crore rupees to countries around the world. He announced a next global plan for the state.
why: Export growth from Indian states contributes to national trade flows and foreign exchange earnings, which affect India's current account and rupee.
